title: Provider-neutral Forge seam with a GitHub adapter
summary: Introduces a `forge` module that defines a provider-neutral `Forge` trait (branch, pull request, status block, review, check status, capabilities) plus a pure `report_change` step and an in-memory `FakeForge` double. A new `github` module becomes the first adapter, moving all `gh` process work out of `pr_status` and `review` into one place, and the CLI's review-post, status-apply, status-refresh and a new `forge pr open` command now go through the trait. `pr_status` keeps only pure parsing (`parse_checks`, `gates_from_checks`), and `GhClient` gains a raw `run` method the adapter drives.

nodes.label: osf review post
nodes.subtitle: review_post_cmd

nodes.label: osf pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_apply_cmd
nodes.summary: Dry run still reads the body through the client; a real apply now calls `Forge::write_status_block` instead of reading and editing itself.

nodes.label: osf pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_refresh_run
nodes.summary: Reads gates through `Forge::read_check_status` and writes the block through `Forge::write_status_block`, while review and PR info still come from the raw client.

nodes.label: osf forge pr open
nodes.subtitle: forge_pr_open_cmd
nodes.summary: New command: requires a builder token, resolves the repo from `--repo` or the origin remote, reads the body file, prepends the work item, and opens a pull request through the forge.

nodes.label: github_adapter()
nodes.subtitle: fn github_adapter()
nodes.summary: The single place that constructs `GitHub<RealGh>`; every CLI path that needs a forge calls it.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: trait Forge: Send + Sync
nodes.summary: Seven operations: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, head_commit, capabilities. Object-safe and provider-neutral by construction.

nodes.label: Forge data types
nodes.subtitle: PullRequestId, Verdict, ReadOutcome, Capabilities
nodes.summary: Plain serializable request/response types, including `ReadOutcome` (Found/Empty/Unknown) and `Capabilities` (verdict and check-status permissions).

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: fn report_change(&dyn Forge, &ReportRequest)
nodes.summary: The engine's Report step as pure run code: open PR, write status block, read capabilities, gate the review on the verdict capability, post, then read checks — stopping at the first failed step.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory Forge double
nodes.summary: Records every call as data, scripts per-operation answers, and can be told to fail an operation; performs no process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: Implements every `Forge` operation over a `GhClient`: API POSTs for branch and PR creation, body read/apply/edit for the status block, review posting with self-review fallback, checks parsing, and capability probing from logins and check errors.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.subtitle: impl GhClient
nodes.summary: The only code that spawns the command-line tool: `run` with optional stdin, plus body/review/info/checks reads and the temp-file body edit.

nodes.label: GhClient trait
nodes.subtitle: pr_status::GhClient
nodes.summary: Gains a raw `run(args, stdin) -> GhOutput` method so the adapter can drive arbitrary commands; the existing typed reads remain for the CLI's direct uses.

nodes.label: pr_status parsing
nodes.subtitle: parse_checks, gates_from_checks, apply
nodes.summary: Process code removed; checks parsing split into `parse_checks` (triples) and `gates_from_checks` (gate spec), with `gates_from_checks_json` kept as a thin wrapper.

nodes.label: review decisions
nodes.subtitle: payload, after_first_attempt, classify_post_result
nodes.summary: `fetch_head_sha` and `post_via_gh` removed; `parse_head_sha_json` made public so the adapter can reuse it. The pure payload and fallback decision functions stay.
